title: Aayi Falak Tasht Kuja O Sar E Shabbir Kuja
body:
Aayi Falak Tasht Kuja O Sar E Shabbir Kuja
Bazme Mai Khwar Kuja Zainab E Dilgeer Kuja
1. Yousuf E Aal E Nabi Boodh Aseer E Zindaan
Haaif Sajjad Kuja Tauq E Gulugeer Kuja
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Khoob Serab Ghamo Dand Layeen Asgher E Raa
Teer E Faulaad Kuja Gardan E Besheer Kuja
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Dukhter E Uqda Kushayi Do Jahan Gashta Aseer
Majlis E Shaam Kuja Sahib E Tatheer Kuja
